tonight.headline: Tuten is still limited — and your lineup still has no net under him
body: Bad news first: Tuten was limited Wednesday with his ankle/foot and is still QUESTIONABLE, and as of this morning's snapshot the lineup is unchanged — Diggs in FLEX, Gordon on the bench. If Jacksonville declare Tuten inactive at 13:55 Sunday, nobody on your bench can replace him: every back you own locks at 12:00. One move fixes it (Do-first).

Better news: Waddle practised in full Wednesday, his first since the concussion, so after the fix you have two late fallbacks (Waddle 15:25, Diggs Monday). Fairbairn kicks tonight at 19:15 with Houston 12.5-point favourites. ESPN projects 136.3 to 128.2 and gives you 54%.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Prescott (22.3), Javonte Williams (19.7) and Pickens (15.8) all play Dallas–Tennessee at 12:00 — Tennessee allow the most WR points in our source — so one Cowboys shootout moves three of Panda Attack's starters at once (league file).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten inactive with no live fallback — about 17 projected points to zero. The Do-first card is the fix and costs nothing.

case.label: The problem
case.body: As set at 12:50Z, Tuten sits in an RB slot and every back on your bench plays at 12:00 (Gordon at Buffalo, Etienne at Chicago). Jacksonville–New York kicks off at 15:25; inactives come at 13:55, after both lock.

case.label: The player
case.body: Tuten was limited Wednesday with his ankle/foot (Giants.com Jaguars report 18 Nov). Last week he missed two practices and still handled 29 touches — he will probably play, but the label is real until Friday.

case.label: What changed since yesterday
case.body: Waddle practised in full Wednesday, his first since the Week 9 concussion (NBC 18 Nov). With Tuten in FLEX, Waddle (Sunday 15:25) joins Diggs (Monday 19:15) as a fallback that is still unlocked at 13:55.

case.label: The fix
case.body: Gordon (13.9) into an RB slot, Tuten (17.0) into FLEX, Diggs (13.0) to the bench. That is the lineup check's projection lineup — Gordon over Diggs is a 0.9 coin flip, taken by rule.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is inactive and the FLEX still scores zero because the swap was not made before 12:00. The Gordon-Diggs choice inside it is a coin flip and is not graded as a thesis.

lineupCheck.verdict: The projection lineup starts Gordon over Diggs (0.9, a coin flip — take it); put Tuten in FLEX so his fallback is still live at 13:55.
